description: Machine Sync v1 test vectors. Generated by reference.mjs in this directory; do not edit by hand.

encoding.bytes: Raw byte strings are lowercase hex unless the field name says otherwise.
encoding.envelope: Envelopes are standard base64 with padding, as in the changes response body (§6.5).
encoding.associatedData: UTF-8 text, fed to ChaCha20-Poly1305 as its bytes.
encoding.plaintext: The JSON written by the reference implementation, before padding. Readers need not reproduce it byte for byte.

envelopes.description: day blob from §5.2 (one Spend Bucket, pads to 1 KiB)

envelopes.description: day blob larger than 1 KiB (pads to 2 KiB); costUSD omitted where pricing is unknown
envelopes.name: day-2026-09-22

envelopes.description: profile blob whose JSON is exactly 1024 bytes, so it gets no padding
envelopes.name: profile

day envelope replayed under another day name (AAD mismatch)
day envelope replayed into another Sync Group (AAD mismatch)
day envelope with the first ciphertext bit flipped
